row.evidence: Datarails' SAML and Okta guide says 'To enable SCIM-based provisioning, you must generate an authentication token' and copy the SCIM token and base URL into the identity provider, while every plan on the pricing page is 'Request Quote'.
row.notes: Quote-only: Professional (2 users, 1 integration), Premium (5 users) and Expert (15 users + 50 viewers) are all 'Request Quote'. SCIM exists (admin-generated SCIM token and base URL, Members & Groups > SCIM Token, operations run as that admin) but is only documented as a step in the Okta SAML guide; no plan gate, SCIM version, endpoints, attributes or deprovisioning behaviour is published. SAML 2.0 SSO works with any SAML IdP (Okta, Duo, Google Workspace, JumpCloud named), one SAML config per org; the plan that includes SSO is not stated. The Microsoft sign-in app is OAuth/OIDC only and 'does not support provisioning'. Okta OIN 'DataRails' app (2019) is SAML only in markup although its blurb mentions provisioning. No user-management API is documented (the public API uploads files).

auth.token_source: Datarails Admin > Members & Groups > (your user) three-dot menu > SCIM Token; the page also shows the SCIM base URL. SCIM operations run as that user.
auth.notes: Method inferred as a token; the article calls it a 'SCIM token' / 'authentication token' without naming the header scheme.

deprovision.notes: In-product, Deactivate keeps permissions and data and can be reversed; Remove permanently removes the user (c10, c11). Which one SCIM triggers is not documented.

limitations.text: SCIM operations execute under the admin user who generated the token.
The Microsoft (Entra) sign-in app is OAuth/OpenID only and does not support SAML or provisioning.
Only one active SAML configuration per organization.

scim.notes: The only public SCIM documentation is the token-generation step inside the 'SAML and OKTA SSO Configuration' article (updated 2026-01-22). Version, base URL pattern, endpoints, attributes and deprovisioning behaviour are not documented. No plan gate is stated; pricing is quote-only.

user_api.notes: The public Datarails API (Data Gateway Service, POST https://app.datarails.com/api/v1/fileboxes/upload_file with basic auth) uploads files to Fileboxes; no user-management API is documented in the 260 public help-centre articles.

okta.notes: OIN 'DataRails' (last updated Oct. 7 2019) marks only SAML (page markup), although the blurb says it 'handles user access, single sign-on and provisioning'. Datarails' own guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app plus the SCIM token, so row idp.okta is via_generic.

entra.notes: Not in the Entra SaaS tutorial index; Datarails' own guide adds its multi-tenant app (ID d57a5c0f-...) by consent; OAuth/OIDC only, no provisioning.

google.notes: Datarails names Google Workspace as a SAML provider; Google catalogue not checked.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud named as a SAML provider; SCIM with JumpCloud not documented.
